release_gate: Measured encodes wait for coordinator acceptance of this result boundary and tested R0 claims. Generation is not a prerequisite.
decision_and_hypothesis: At display_low (360 short-edge, 12 fps, no extra source frames) on one development scene, slowest-preset AV1 and VVC two-point RD plus encode/decode time can be collected inside six settings and 30 minutes. Competing explanation: slowest presets at even 48 frames exceed the budget and need a costed extension before native endpoints.

anchors_rd.why_not_this_card: native 4K development RD, unverified reconstruction/ledger for validated claims

evidence_reused.gap: No validated display_low paired AV1/VVC points on identical native-timestamp frames with decode and calibration controls.

operating_regime.timestamp_policy: Use experiments.long_scenes.extract.extract_or_reuse_24fps_frames at t_start=80.7807, then take zero-based extracted-frame positions 0,2,...,94. This is the existing non-interpolating 24 fps extraction route followed by deterministic decimation to 12 fps; record extracted_frame_index and target_time_s=t_start+index/24. Do not label these as native source PTS.

source_transform.reuse_boundary: Reuse the scene extraction files, not the old BP46 eligible interval [68,164). This card selects extraction positions [0,96) then decimates; it is a distinct scene-start anchor input and must receive its own stack hash. E04 pairing must use this same selected-position list and aligned masks.

existing_encoding_route.warning: timed_roundtrip deletes its temporary charged bitstream. Before launch, the dispatched worker must add only a bounded persistent wrapper around the same src.components.codec.encode.encode/decode path so each charged bitstream, decoded output, EncodeRecord.command, and byte length survive. Do not invent native codec flags or launch through a second encoder path.

controls: standalone_decode of charged bitstream to exact frame count and even 360-short-edge shape
run the fixed display_low calibration choice below before reading anchor scores
wire bytes equal measured bitstream length
smallest_discriminating_probe.control_budget_share: at least one third of wall time for decode, calibration and scoring

unrelated.reason: caller-supplied natural tennis control on the same 360p grid; do not use the synthetic fallback

metric_calibration.pass: all requested metrics report distortion_ordering_held and unrelated_ordering_held; quote unrelated values beside results
metric_calibration.on_failure: stop before reading or plotting anchor scores

bounds_and_instrument.size_bytes: Worst: both QPs near uncompressed 360p 48f (~3e7). Best: QP63 under 5e4 bytes with a valid decode.
bounds_and_instrument.psnr_y_db: Worst: <15 (decode/colour mismatch). Best: >40 (mild QP on easy tennis).
bounds_and_instrument.encode_plus_decode_s: Worst: >30 min total for four settings (then stop and cost an extension). Best: <10 min total.
bounds_and_instrument.null: unrelated reconstruction must not outrank the decode on PSNR/SSIM/VMAF

budget.if_exceeded: return a costed 24-frame or faster-preset diagnostic; do not silently drop slowest preset
budget.full_scene_note: federer scene_007 / alcaraz scene_000 full duration at 12 fps exceeds this first card; keep 48 frames until the 30-minute question is answered

decision_rule.promote: four usable overlapping points with controls, recorded binaries, and ingestable campaign_result.v1 rows
decision_rule.stop: a slowest-preset encode cannot finish one QP inside 15 minutes: cost native vs faster-preset split
decision_rule.inconclusive: decode shape/count mismatch or calibration alarm: do not plot RD
